notes.title: Furry Company officially launches on Steam on July 15th!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Bosses![/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that our cozy and relaxing desktop idle simulation game [i][b]Furry Company[/b][/i] will officially launch on [b]July 15, 2025（CST）[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535823/fb900fa3a2f9700a4d71e67769f98f27070665b1.png"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Furry Company[/i], you’ll become the real "boss behind the scenes" of a company:[/p][p]🐕 Recruit animal employees with unique personalities[/p][p]🎨 Customize your office, unlock furniture and themed maps[/p][p]💼 Watch your employees work hard (or slack off) while quietly generating income for you[/p][p]✨ You might even encounter rare "hidden characters" that only appear on specific maps!This is a relaxing idle sim perfect for playing while studying, working, or simply taking a break.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535823/9e2eb7e1492947e9aa126318bfc3b00c4e46a34f.png"][/img][/p][p]We hope [i]Furry Company[/i] becomes a warm little corner in your everyday life.[/p][p]If you’d like to chat, give suggestions, or just hang out, we’d love to welcome you in our Discord![/p][p]🧸 July 15[b]（CST）[/b] — we’ll be waiting at the office for you to report in!— From the dev team of [i]Furry Company[/i], with a whole fluffy heart.[/p]

notes.title: [Bug Fix Announcement] Windows 11 Black Screen Issue
notes.notes: [p][b]Dear Bosses,[/b][/p][p][b]Hello everyone ! We’ve noticed that some bosses using Windows 11 are experiencing a black screen issue when launching Furry Company. Our technical team has identified the cause and implemented a fix. Please follow the steps below in order to resolve the issue and restore your gaming experience: [/b][/p][p][b]● In "This PC", search for the file at the following path (Note: the “pc” shown in the image refers to your actual user name on your computer) .[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535823/62ccc7ce7510745201da22a738242ab034bec484.png"][/img][/p][p][b]● If the file doesn't appear, please enable the "Hidden items" option in the View settings .[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535823/59e1a2c33f7a67ed8a65369f02891a4f7775ba7a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]● Open the file and change the value shown below from "windowState": false to "windowState": true. [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535823/c1b7f754eb9db5f7868d63753d454fb105478243.png"][/img][/p][p][b]● Save the file and exit.[/b][/p][p][b]● Restart the game to test whether the issue has been resolved.[/b][/p][p][b]Thank you for your understanding and patience! If you have any questions, join our discord channel and feel free to report them in the channel #bug-report or directly contact us @Admin.[/b][/p][p][b]Happy gaming![/b][/p]

notes.title: [Update Announcement] ver1.0.1
notes.notes: [p]Dear Bosses, [/p][p]Hello everyone! Thank you for all your valuable feedback and suggestions. We've made several optimizations based on your input, and we hope this update will bring you an even better gaming experience~ [/p][p][/p][p]\[Bug Fixes] [/p][p]Fixed the issue in Minimize mode where the animal’s mood and satiety levels dropped excessively.[/p][p]Fixed the issue with claw coins when zooming in and out on the Magic Castle page. [/p][p][/p][p]\[Optimizations & Adjustments] [/p][p]Added a text reminder when you don’t have enough claw coins to open packs or boxes. [/p][p]Added a secondary confirmation window when creating a new save file. [/p][p]Added a toggle for the “transparent pass-through” effect, which is enabled by default. If players experience lag, this effect can be turned off in the settings. [/p][p]Optimized animation frame rate to reduce lag and stuttering. [/p][p]Improved the clarity of item descriptions for furniture and food-related props.[/p][p] [/p][p]\[Next] [/p][p]We are currently working on an urgent fix for the bug that prevents players from achieving the 1000 and 5000 claw coins per second achievements.[/p][p][/p]
